recipes.name: TRES LECHES CAKE
ingredients: 10 eggs, separated by whites and yolks
instructions: Separate eggs, putting the whites into the bowl of a stand mixer. Set the yolks aside. - 10 eggs separated by whites and yolks
Beat the whites on high speed with the whisk attachment of the stand mixer while slowly adding white sugar. Keep whipping until stiff peaks form. - 1 cups white sugar divided
In a separate stand mixer bowl, beat the egg yolks with the sugar, mixing on medium speed with the paddle attachment for about 2 minutes - until pale and smooth. - 1 cups white sugar divided
In a separate bowl, combine all purpose flour, baking powder, and salt. Whisk to combine. - 9 ½ ounces all purpose flour - 3 tsp baking powder - ½ tsp salt

Add milk to the egg yolk mixture along with vanilla extract. Mix until completely combined. Next, add the bowl of dry ingredients and mix until completely combined. - ⅔ cup milk - 1 ½ tsp vanilla extract
Next, add the egg white meringue to the other bowl. Gently stir to combine, being careful not to deflate the egg whites.
Prepare your baking pans. First, cut your parchment paper into rounds for the bottom of your pan.
Watch the video to see how I do it! Then, grease both pans with vegetable oil. - Vegetable oil (for greasing pans)
Pour the batter evenly between the two pans. Spread to smooth out the top.
Bake at 350°F for 25-35 minutes, or until a cake tester comes out clean.
While the cake is baking, make the dulce de leche.

To make the dulce de leche, combine sugar, milk, and baking soda into a saucepan. Stir gently to combine over a medium heat until it comes to a rolling boil. - 1 ¼ cup white sugar - 4 cups milk - ¼ tsp baking soda

Once boiling, lower the heat and simmer for 90 minutes, whisking frequently to prevent scorching. It should reach a deep golden brown color. Once it is finished, strain through a fine mesh sieve and allow to cool at room temperature for at least one hour.
Once the cakes have cooled, remove them from pan and remove parchment paper. Put the cakes back in their respective pans. Poke holes along the top of both cakes with a fork.
In a bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk, evaporated milk, and whole milk. - 1 can 14oz. sweetened condensed milk - 1 can 12ox. evaporated milk - 4 ounces whole milk
Ladle the tres leches mixture over top of the cakes. Cover the cakes and refrigerate for at least 6 hours, preferably overnight.

Make the whipped cream: in the bowl of a stand mixer with the whisk attachment, combine heavy whipping cream, sugar, and vanilla extract. Beat over medium speed until stiff peaks form. - 8 ounces heavy whipping cream - 2 tbsp sugar - 1 tsp vanilla extract

Place one later cake onto a cake stand or plate. Cover with whipped cream all over. Top with a drizzle of dulce de leche, and then garnish with sliced strawberries. Serve and enjoy! - Thinly sliced strawberries (for garnish)
